author: Carl J. Wenzinger and Thomas A. Harris
title: Wind-Tunnel Investigation of an NACA 23012 Airfoil with Various Arrangements of Slotted Flaps
used: Printed pp.4-5: geometry, conditions, precision and fittings; p.24 Fig31: envelope-polar interpretation; pp.30-31 Tables I-II: coordinates. PDF page = printed page + 4.
conditions_qualification: Physical Re2.19e6. Effective Re3.5e6 is a historical tunnel-turbulence correction, not the input physical Reynolds number. Ncrit unknown; Mach not directly reported.
observable_qualification: Drag includes hinge fittings, approximately CD0.001 for neutral sealed configurations. No measured correction for deflected flaps. Envelope polars change flap position/deflection along the curve; not a single geometry polar.
